---
title: "1 · From Artificial Intelligence to Neural Networks"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

The lecture opens with goals of quantum physics that machine learning can serve and places deep learning within artificial intelligence, where programs are learned from data and the features that describe the data are learned by the network. We then introduce a neural network as a non-linear function with parameters. Without a non-linear activation, extra layers add no expressive power. With ReLU units a network approximates any continuous curve by straight pieces, and a steep sigmoid approximates a step, which leads to the universal approximation theorem. The lecture closes with regression and classification and with the literature of the course.
